people.name: Kadesh
people.line: An important oasis in the Wilderness of Zin

translations.web: Yahweh’s voice shakes the wilderness. Yahweh shakes the wilderness of Kadesh.
translations.bsb: The voice of the LORD shakes the wilderness; the LORD shakes the Wilderness of Kadesh.
translations.kjv: The voice of the LORD shaketh the wilderness; the LORD shaketh the wilderness of Kadesh.
translations.asv: The voice of Jehovah shaketh the wilderness; Jehovah shaketh the wilderness of Kadesh.
